$description: Overdrive design tokens: the source of truth for android/ui-kit and the mock-ups. Units: dp for sizes, sp for type, ms for motion. Generated outputs: design/mockups/tokens.css (design/tools/build-tokens.mjs). See design/system.md for usage rules.

neutral.$description: Cool near-black ramp (OKLCH hue ~250, chroma <= 0.012). Dark theme only.

surface1.use: Cards, tile groups, bars, list containers

surface2.use: Secondary buttons, inputs, chips, notices, icon wells

surface3.use: Pressed and selected state of surface2 controls; slider track fill

border.use: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, chart gridlines

borderStrong.use: Input outline, selected segment outline, chart axis baseline

text.$description: Contrast on bg / surface1 / surface2: primary 17.7 / 16.6 / 15.1, secondary 8.8 / 8.2 / 7.5, tertiary 5.4 / 5.1 / 4.6.

tertiary.use: Labels above numbers, axis ticks, placeholders, the empty-value dash

onPrimary.use: Text and icons on a primary (light) button or on a zone fill

zone.$description: The only accent. Coggan power zones by % of FTP. Every zone keeps >= 7:1 against the overlay backing composited over white video at the default opacity and >= 7.3:1 on surface1. Always paired with the zone number or a chart position: colour is never the only channel.

rules.boundaries: Zone of a power value p with FTP f: pct = round(100 * p / f); z1 if pct <= 55, z2 if <= 75, z3 if <= 90, z4 if <= 105, z5 if <= 120, z6 if <= 150, else z7.
rules.asText: Zone colour may colour text only for the live power value (and target power in the workout card), and only on bg, surface1 or the overlay backing. Never on surface2 or lighter.
rules.asFill: Chart marks and zone chips use the zone colour at 100%. Text on a zone fill is text.onPrimary.
rules.past: Elapsed parts of a workout profile are drawn at alpha pastAlpha.
rules.onBacking: On the overlay the zone colour is applied as-is (no tint, no glow). Below the default backing opacity Z6 and Z7 fall under 7:1 on white video; at the 85% floor every zone stays >= 5.5:1.

backing.use: Overlay window fill, drawn at overlay.opacity.default

scrim.use: Behind dialogs and the finish-ride sheet (70% black)

numerals.rule: Every number that can change is set with the OpenType feature tnum (Compose: fontFeatureSettings = "tnum"; CSS: font-feature-settings: "tnum"). Geist's tabular digits are 0.600 em (400), 0.612 em (500), 0.624 em (600) wide. A live value sits in a slot whose width is fixed to its widest possible string, so neither the value nor its neighbours ever move.

scale.$description: size and lineHeight in sp, weight as CSS/Compose FontWeight, tracking in em.

numL.use: Ride screen stat tiles, interval time left

numXS.use: Values in list rows and tables

label.use: Labels above numbers, chips, secondary buttons

caption.use: Overlay labels, chart ticks and direct labels

space.$description: 4 dp grid. Name = multiple of 4 dp.

use.sm: Chart bar ends, zone chip, progress bars

stroke.use: hairline for borders, dividers, gridlines; focus ring is text.primary, offset 2 dp

slots.$description: Fixed slot widths in dp (widest string, tnum, at its type size), so nothing reflows.

gearOrTarget.note: One slot for both, sized by the label, so the window never resizes between ERG and free-ride steps

coach.$description: The live coach under the overlay panel (spec 12.1, docs/adr/0039): a mute control while a session is on, and a plate with the cue being spoken. Each is a surface of its own, 464 dp wide like the panel, so the panel's geometry never changes.

blur.note: Optional setting. Android 12+ FLAG_BLUR_BEHIND with blurBehindRadius. Blur only calms busy video; it does not darken a bright frame, so the backing keeps the opacity setting unchanged. Costs GPU every frame the video changes; off by default and hidden where cross-window blur is unsupported.

ftpLine.label: FTP, caption, text.tertiary, right-aligned above the line

motion.$description: Nothing moves on the overlay unless the rider moves it. No animation is longer than 250 ms; nothing loops except the device-search spinner.

use.valueChange: instant: numbers swap, never roll or fade
use.overlaySnap: snap + decelerate, only after a drag ends
use.sheet: standard + decelerate in, fast + accelerate out
use.spinner: spinner + linear, repeat, only while a device search runs
